svg.text: An image is an array of numbers
a "pixel" or "voxel" is just one element of the array
NumPy indexing is written [row, col] → [y, x], and the first index is 0, not 1
Color axis vs. channel axis — they're different!
napari auto-detects and renders it as color
often shown as separate colormapped layers
trailing (Y, X, 3/4) → treated as RGB(A); pass channel_axis= for anything else
same shape as an image array, but values mean "which object" —
so napari colors them by category, not by brightness
Bonus: not everything is a dense array
a few (y, x) coordinates define the shape
napari's Points, Shapes, Vectors, and Tracks layers store coordinates, not pixel grids
